title: Requirement
description: Data schema for a generic unlock requirement in Cardinal Weapon Framework.

description.description: Human-readable requirement description shown in UI (e.g., 'Defeat 10 Dire Wolves').

targetId.description: Target identifier (e.g., ActorBase ID, Item FormID, Quest ID, Location FormID).

targetValue.description: Numeric target value (e.g., required kill count, level threshold, quest stage).

scriptName.description: Optional script name for custom Papyrus/C++ condition handlers.
